evidence: The validation set exhibits temporal drift. While raw popularity bucket features (E0021) did not improve the baseline, normalized quality signals such as engagement rates often generalize better out-of-time.
expected_effect: A smoothed long-view rate will provide a more stable, quality-focused signal for unseen or temporally shifted validation data, improving ranking metrics.
hypothesis: Bucketizing the training-only video long-view rate with a Bayesian smoothing prior will enable the model to learn reliable video quality embeddings, resulting in an improved validation ranking.
